people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Get up! Why have you fallen on your face like that?
translations.bsb: But the LORD said to Joshua, “Stand up! Why have you fallen on your face?
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face?
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore art thou thus fallen upon thy face?
